chunks: Al-ʿAlāʾ ibn Razīn narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:
Jibrāʾīl عليه السلام enjoined me concerning the woman so much that I thought her divorce should not be appropriate except for a clear indecency.

key_terms.أَوْصَانِي: He gave me repeated counsel or injunction
key_terms.بِٱلْمَرْأَةِ: Concerning the woman; regarding the wife and her treatment
key_terms.جَبْرَئِيلُ: Jibrāʾīl, the angel who conveyed divine instruction
key_terms.طَلَاقُهَا: Her divorce; dissolving the marriage bond
key_terms.فَاحِشَةٍ: A grave indecency or outrageous immoral act

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith teach about women’s rights and the seriousness of divorce in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the great concern that Islam places on the rights and dignified treatment of women within marriage. The repeated counsel of Jibrāʾīl عليه السلام impressed upon the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم that divorce is not to be taken lightly, and is only associated here with an unmistakably grave violation.
